tool_args.rationale: The measurements show a smooth saturating response to input and inhibition by sink gradient. Fit a flexible rational response numerically and use fresh confirmation to test its predictive adequacy; dependence on unvaried inputs is not identified by these data.

considered_alternatives.option: Pure Newton cooling or quartic radiative loss
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither recalled law accounts for both the observed saturation with input and strong sink-gradient dependence.
All observations have the same horizon and initial state, leaving transient parameters unidentified; the target horizon is the observed horizon.
The two available relevant probes have already been acquired; their rows support fitting the target-horizon response surface.
